data: Which line on the graph represents the retrieval performance of text retrieval at 1?

The question asks which line on the graph represents the retrieval performance of text retrieval at 1. From the caption, we know that the figure is about a "Noise vs Performance study on ActivityNet-captions dataset (val1)". The lines in the graph represent different types of retrieval performance: Video R@1, Video R@5, Text R@1, and Text R@5. 

Looking at the legend, the line representing "Text R@1" is the brown line. Therefore, the brown line represents the retrieval performance of text retrieval at 1.
